name: ga-payroll-social
description: Gabon payroll reference for salary IRPP, complementary salary tax, pension contribution shares, health insurance and employer filing records. It addresses CNSS, CNAMGS, TCS and payroll withholding questions for private employment, while separating distinct contribution bases and dates. Use this Guide to identify the facts, statutory computation and source documents needed before preparing a working paper. It separates the historical code baseline from the enacted finance-law amendments read for this draft. It does not certify the complete 2026 amendment chain or authenticated filing screens. Missing procedures and unresolved old topics are listed explicitly, and the pack remains partial until those gaps and independent review are complete.
